Title: Automated peanut defect detection using hyperspectral imaging and deep learning: A real-time approach for smart agriculture
Authors: Shih-Yu Chen; Yu-Cheng Wu; Yung-Ming Kuo; Rui-Hong Zhang; Tsai-Yi Cheng; Yu-Chien Chen; Po-Yu Chu; Li-Wei Kang; Chinsu Lin
University_Institute: National Yunlin University of Science and Technology
Algorithm_Model: 1D/2D/3D-CNN, SVM; PCA band selection; Group Norm; SoftMax
Authors_Stated_Limitations: Focus on physical defects not internal; equipment cost
Our_Critical_Limitation: Hyperspectral camera is very expensive — not reproducible for smallholder
Relevance_to_AgriNut: Shows controlled light + band selection logic; HSI too costly for us
Potential_Gap_Extension: RGB-only low-cost alternative to HSI; validate if RGB enough

Title: Enhancing peanut pre-sizing with PodTracker: A multiple pod tracking algorithm
Authors: Enrique E. Pena Martinez; Michael W. Kudenov; Jeff Dunne; Nick Garrity
Algorithm_Model: Mask R-CNN; MOT (PodTracker vs DeepSortMask); Decision Tree
Math_Methods: IoU, Euclidean distance, Kalman filter, Hungarian, RMSE
Reported_Metrics: Mask R-CNN AP 86.3(Fancy)/80.0(No.1); PodTracker RMSE_adj 7.64; F1>0.83
Authors_Stated_Limitations: Sizing only, no quality grading, no sorting
Our_Critical_Limitation: Sizes/counts only — does NOT grade good/bad or sort physically
Relevance_to_AgriNut: Tracking math (IoU+distance) reusable for multi-peanut handling
Potential_Gap_Extension: Add quality grading + physical sorting to tracking

Title: FPGA-accelerated convolutional method for peanut pod appearance recognition

Title: Method of Peanut Pod Quality Detection Based on Improved ResNet
Authors: Lili Yang; Changlong Wang; Jianfeng Yu; Nan Xu; Dongwei Wang
Defects_Attributes: Normal, insect pest, mildew, single fruit, damaged, sprouted
Algorithm_Model: PQDA = Improved ResNet18 + KRSNet + CSPNet + CBAM
Authors_Stated_Limitations: Learning ability weakened by lightweighting (trade-off noted)
Our_Critical_Limitation: Only pods not kernels; no deployment test; single capture setup
Relevance_to_AgriNut: Strong class taxonomy (6 defects) reusable for labeling

Title: A novel method for peanut variety identification and classification by Improved VGG16
Authors: Haoyan Yang; Jiangong Ni; Jiyue Gao; Zhongzhi Han; Tao Luan
Algorithm_Model: Improved VGG16 + Inception-style concat + GAP + BN
Our_Critical_Limitation: Variety not quality; scanner not field camera; metric inconsistencies
Potential_Gap_Extension: Field-camera robustness vs scanner; quality not variety

Title: Rapid and accurate detection of peanut pod appearance quality based on lightweight and improved YOLOv5_SSE model
Authors: Zhixia Liu; Xilin Zhong; Chunyu Wang; Guozhen Wu; Fengyu He; Jing Wang; Dexu Yang
Math_Methods: Convolution, SE attention, IoU/EIoU loss, mAP
